    The
    UConn Huskies won the 2025 NCAA Division I women's basketball championship, defeating the South Carolina Gamecocks 82–59 on April 6, 2025, in Tampa, Florida. This victory marked UConn's 12th national championship, breaking the tie with the UCLA men's team for the most in college basketball history. 
    Key Details: 
    • Final Score: UConn 82, South Carolina 59
    • Coach: Geno Auriemma (12th title)
    • Key Performers: Azzi Fudd scored 24 points and Sarah Strong added 24 points with 15 rebounds.
    • Tournament Standing: UConn finished the season 37-3, while South Carolina entered the championship as a No. 1 seed.
    • Highlights: The game was a rematch of the 2022 championship game, with UConn securing their first title since 2016.
